started: Loresoft YouTube Clipster started. Copy a YouTube link to start a download.
only_one_instance: The program is already running. Only one instance is allowed.
only_one_instance_pid: The program is already running (PID {pid}). Only one instance is allowed.

tray_minimized_click: YouTube Clipster keeps running in the system tray. Click the tray icon to open this window again.
link_received: YouTube link received, preparing the process...
nav_already: This video has already been downloaded.

error_unavailable: This video is not available (private, deleted or region locked).
error_metadata:

{details}
error_not_a_link: That is not a YouTube link.
settings_intro: Changes are saved to the configuration file and take effect immediately unless noted otherwise.
settings_open_view: Open this window after a download
settings_open_folder: Open the download folder after a download
settings_clear_clipboard: Clear the clipboard after a download
settings_ask_audio: Ask for the audio track on multilingual videos
settings_no_playlist: Only the single video, never the whole playlist
settings_use_tray: Show an icon in the system tray
settings_start_minimized: Start in the tray without a window
settings_restart_note: Interface language and the tray icon are applied the next time the program starts.
about_text: Downloads YouTube videos or audio automatically as soon as a YouTube link is copied to the clipboard. One Python code base for Linux, Windows and macOS.
about_license: GPLv3 - the author's name (Joachim Ruf, Loresoft.de) must be credited upon publication and modification.

dep_ytdlp: downloading videos and reading video metadata
dep_appindicator: the context menu of the tray icon
dep_xlib: the tray icon on X11 without PyGObject

dep_clipboard: reliable clipboard reading (Tk is the fallback)
dep_js: a few yt-dlp extractors that run JavaScript
